comments.content: `reinterpret_cast` between `shared_ptr<list<shared_ptr<ModelLibraryLocal>>>&` and `shared_ptr<list<shared_ptr<ModelLibrary>>>&` is undefined behavior; these are unrelated types and the reinterpretation of the underlying control block/list is not guaranteed to work even though the element types are related by inheritance. This can cause subtle memory/ABI issues. Consider building a new list of upcasted `shared_ptr<ModelLibrary>` (copying element pointers, which is a valid derived->base shared_ptr conversion) and returning that instead.
Missing newline at end of file. Add a trailing newline to avoid warnings from some compilers/tooling.

`getModel(libraryName, uuid)` ignores the libraryName and delegates to `getModel(uuid)`, which searches the external manager first and falls back to local. When called from `ModelLibrary::getModelTree` for a local library, this could return an external model with the same UUID rather than the intended library's model. Consider honoring `libraryName` (or at least documenting this precedence) to avoid returning the wrong library's model.
